To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the governance function of the capital market is more important than the provision of capital in explaining firm performance.

(i) capital markets provide a conduit for governance services, (ii) the governance services provided by capital markets are positively related to improvements in firm efficiency, and (iii) capital markets provide capital that induces technological change.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of capital market intermediaries in providing governance services to firms.
the role of capital market intermediation in facilitating efficient resource allocation.
the role of financial markets as a source of governance services and its impact on efficiency.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the governance function of capital markets has a positive effect on firm-level performance, while the capital provision function has a positive effect at the industry level.
governance services provided by the capital markets, as distinct from capital, are a significant determinant of efficiency, growth, and productivity.
the capital market is not only a conduit for the provision of capital, but also a source of governance services, which in turn, affect efficiency.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the market for corporate control is a mechanism for allocating capital and monitoring the use of capital, which in turn affects the efficiency with which the capital is utilized.
capital market institutions have a significant impact on the efficiency of resource allocation within firms and industries.
capital markets are a conduit of governance services that improve the efficiency with which capital is utilized within the firm.
The main takeaway from our work is that
capital markets are not just about capital provision.
capital markets perform an important governance function that facilitates improvements in the allocation and utilization of resources within the firm.
the governance function of capital markets is important for economic efficiency and growth.
